name: desapeguese-site
description: Festival Desapegue-se — static site hosted on Wix Headless

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html dist/index.html
scripts.preview: npm run build && CI=1 npx @wix/cli@1.1.268 preview
scripts.release: npm run build && CI=1 npx @wix/cli@1.1.268 release
scripts.serve: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory dist
